sources.title: collaborator: collab-electron/src/main/pty.ts
sources.locator: PTY launch; src/main/config.ts, json-rpc-server.ts, analytics.ts, integrations.ts; CLI and tile/persistence models
sources.finding: Pinned Electron main/renderer source implements local PTY terminals and local JSON canvas/tile state. The native app has no remote execution backend, released browser/mobile client, shared-user account service, role/SSO system, issue store, task scheduler, PR API or workspace/container/VM provisioning. PostHog analytics initializes from a build-time key with no user opt-out control. Generic shell access does not prove named harness integration.

sources.title: collaborator: collab-electron/packages/collab-canvas-skill/skills/collab-canvas/SKILL.md
sources.locator: Agent in a terminal; terminal write/read; integrations.ts; cli/collab-cli.mjs
sources.finding: The shipped canvas skill instructs an agent to create a terminal, launch Claude Code with a delegated prompt and read its result. The installed CLI controls canvas terminals over local JSON-RPC. integrations.ts detects Claude Code, Codex CLI and Gemini CLI and installs their canvas instructions. Terminals run the user shell with its normal environment and agent login.
